subject: EOQ: pilot conversion credit request for FleetOps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@fleetops.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ: pilot conversion credit request for FleetOps

Hi team — looping you all in. FleetOps has been running the 4-week pilot on Redwood for their routing assistant. They’re at ~85% of the ingestion target and have flagged two conversion blockers: production throughput testing and an extra week of integration time to finalize validation.

I’m proposing a small, targeted credit package to remove friction and capture the expansion: a $4,000 credit pool applied to their pilot account + a 14-day trial extension on the same plan. This is intended as a one-time conversion stimulus to get them across the line by quarter end.

Why this size: based on usage estimates this will cover the staging/perf tests and one full week of higher-throughput validations without forcing them to commit to a paid contract yet. We keep the upside aligned with a 30-day conversion review and an executive check-in.

Requesting: Ben — quick approval for the credit cap and Marissa — confirmation on billing/legal flow and any guardrails we should add (invoice hold, credit expiry, usage tagging).

Attached: EOQ_credit_proposal_fleetops_v2.pdf (proposal, terms recommended).

Thanks — I can jump on a 10-min call if helpful.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda.park@fleetops.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ: pilot conversion credit request for FleetOps

Marcus — thanks for the clear ask. Approved in principle. My quick notes:

- Approve up to $4,000 credit applied to the pilot account.
- Credit term: 30 days from issuance, single-use, non-transferable.
- Condition: execute an abbreviated conversion MSA/quote (we won’t need a full contract for this action, but we should capture intent in HubSpot and DocuSign).

Marissa — please confirm accounting code and whether we need a formal approval ticket for finance. I want this to be fast — goal is to get FleetOps back into high throughput testing before Friday.

Ben

Director, Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00

Sounds fine — route approved. A couple of practical items from rev/op:

1) Please use billing code: PROMO-EOQ-2027-FLT when creating the credit in our ledger.
2) We need a one-page amendment/quote that references the credit amount and expiry; I’ll run that through finance for visibility.
3) Attach a tiny "credit redline" sheet so finance can see breakouts (I attached it here).

I kicked off a DocuSign envelope template for the quote (placeholder link below). Once Marcus confirms the exact credit value and account id, I’ll issue the credit and tag it to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the quick move on this. Confirming FleetOps accepts the $4,000 credit and the requested 14-day extension (the additional time will let our SRE run the production-like throughput tests). Two quick asks from our side:

- Please apply credits to account id "fleetops-prod-pilot".
- Can you schedule a 30-minute handoff with our SRE (available Friday 9–11am PT)?

Best,

Thanks Linda — glad we could move fast. Quick status update / next steps: 

- Credit amount: $4,000 (approved). I’ve asked Marissa to issue under billing code PROMO-EOQ-2027-FLT and to attach to HubSpot deal RDW-2027-FLT-0043.
- Applied to account: fleetops-prod-pilot (will be visible in the billing console after issuance).
- DocuSign: I’ll send the one-page quote via the link Marissa provided; procurement should receive it within the hour.
- SRE handoff: Friday 2027-07-16 at 10:00am PT — invite sent to Linda and FleetOps SRE. Agenda: quick ramp checklist, KV cache sizing note, and expected throughput window.

Closing note: tagging this as an EOQ small-batch conversion incentive. I’ll follow up post-handoff with a short exec summary and churn-risk notes if anything pops.
